extra_constructs.independent_construct_truth: Four very wide .99 front Gaussians trigger native early stop before both rear Gaussians on every frame pixel.
Projected front dark/bright and rear bright/dark pairs have opposite signed color terms; front opacity .4 and conditional rear 2/3 match center weights.
